body.statement:
There exists one total Borel measurable radius \(R_\ell\), namely the pilot-split radius in \(\mathrm{def:pilot\mbox{-}split\mbox{-}certified\mbox{-}radius}\), using pilot sizes \(\lceil n_\ell^{3/4}\rceil\) and \(\lceil m_\ell^{3/4}\rceil\), main-sample centers, exclusion budget \(\beta_\ell=(n_\ell\wedge m_\ell)^{-2}\), deterministic ordering and tie-breaking, exhaustive compatible support-cluster, covariance-rank, and simplex-face enumeration, and certified rational interval arithmetic.  It satisfies
\[
 \liminf_{\ell\to\infty}\inf_{P\in\mathcal M}
 \Pr_P\{(\tau_{t,\ell})_{t>T_0}\in\mathcal C_\ell(R_\ell)\}
 \geq1-\alpha,
\]
and its confidence-set diameter is \(O_{\Pr}(n_\ell^{-1/2}+m_\ell^{-1/4})\) uniformly over \(\mathcal M\).  On every supported fixed local stratum, the DKW branch has probability \(o(1)\), the pilot region converges in the quotient parameterization, every bounded within-cell root-\(m_\ell\) offset is learned, every cross-cell translation and finite simplex-face offset remains in \(\Gamma_\eta\), and
\[
 R_\ell^2/a_\ell\longrightarrow c^*(\eta,\alpha)
 \quad\text{in conditional probability given }\mathscr S_\eta.
\]
Only on a fixed stratum with unscaled knot separation, all weights bounded away from simplex faces, and a continuous nondegenerate critical law does the nuisance region collapse and the radius reduce to the corresponding separated oracle cutoff.  At collisions or faces the common nuisance supremum is retained; in particular, the Bernoulli collision honesty penalty cannot be removed by oracle adaptation.
body.proof_tex:
We first distinguish the causal target from the observed-law construction.  Assumption \(\mathrm{ass:stable\mbox{-}quantile\mbox{-}span}\) gives, for every post period,
\[
 \tau_{t,\ell}=Q^I_{0t,\ell}-Q^N_{0t,\ell}
 =Q^I_{0t,\ell}-\sum_{j=1}^Jw_{\ell j}Q_{jt,\ell}.
\tag{23}
\]
Thus the empirical DSC curve is an estimator of (23); it is not made causal by definition.  Positivity and rank enter through \(f\geq f_{\min}>0\) and \(H_\ell|_L\succeq\lambda I_L\), respectively, while finite post support and the common range bound enter through the endpoint representation.

Use the deterministic split and the radius defined in \(\mathrm{def:pilot\mbox{-}split\mbox{-}certified\mbox{-}radius}\).  Empirical order statistics are Borel functions.  The primitive intervals, finite label enumeration, rational grids, interval operations, first-success rule, and DKW fallback are Borel by \(\mathrm{lem:pilot\mbox{-}geometry\mbox{-}gaussian\mbox{-}transfer}\).  Therefore \(R_\ell\) is a total Borel function taking values in \([0,2D]\).

Let \(\mathcal E^P_\ell\) be the pilot inclusion event in (18).  Conditional on the pilot and on \(\mathcal E^P_\ell\), the true finite-array quotient parameter belongs to \(\widehat{\mathcal K}_\ell\).  Let \(L^{M,\mathrm{raw}}_\ell\) denote the maximum, over post periods, of the squared main-center error divided by \(a^M_\ell\).  Apply the exact expansion \(\mathrm{thm:finite\mbox{-}two\mbox{-}source\mbox{-}expansion}\) to the main blocks.  Since \(N_{n,\ell}/n_\ell\to1\) and \(N_{m,\ell}/m_\ell\to1\), its remainder is still \(o_{\Pr}(1)\) after division by \(a^M_\ell\), uniformly over \(\mathcal M\).  The transfer inequality (21), the cushion (22), and the fact that \(\overline c_\ell\) is an upper certified common cutoff give
\[
 \inf_{P\in\mathcal M}
 \Pr_P\{L^{M,\mathrm{raw}}_\ell
       \leq\overline c_\ell+\delta_\ell\mid\text{pilot}\}
 \geq1-\alpha-e_\ell
 \quad\text{on }\mathcal E^P_\ell,
\tag{24}
\]
where
\[
 e_\ell=C\beta_\ell+C\zeta_\ell
       +C(L_{G,R}\gamma_\ell)^{1/2}longrightarrow0.
\tag{25}
\]
The coupling/transfer, linearization, nuisance-exclusion, Gaussian-tail, and interval errors appear separately in (19), (22), (18), the choice of \(G,R\), and the bracket width \(\zeta_\ell\); (25) is their union bound.  Notice that (24) uses the Gaussian probability at the exact level \(1-\alpha\) and a vanishing additive loss cushion.  Therefore it remains valid when the critical law has an atom; no continuity at its quantile is silently assumed.

By definition of \(T^\circ_\ell\),
\[
 \max_{t>T_0}\|\widehat\tau_{t,\ell}-\tau_{t,\ell}\|_2
 \leq T^\circ_\ell+
       \max_{t>T_0}\|\widetilde\tau_{t,\ell}-\tau_{t,\ell}\|_2.
\tag{26}
\]
Hence the successful branch radius covers whenever the event in (24) occurs.  On a failed branch, \(\mathrm{thm:honest\mbox{-}rate\mbox{-}ball}\) gives finite-sample coverage at least \(1-\alpha\).  Taking expectations in (24), using \(\Pr((\mathcal E^P_\ell)^c)\leq C\beta_\ell\), and then applying the subsequence principle proves
\[
 \liminf_{\ell\to\infty}\inf_{P\in\mathcal M}
 \Pr_P\{(\tau_{t,\ell})_{t>T_0}\in\mathcal C_\ell(R_\ell)\}
 \geq1-\alpha.
\tag{27}
\]
Indeed, if (27) failed, a violating sequence of laws would have a local subsubsequence supplied by \(\mathrm{lem:local\mbox{-}subsequence\mbox{-}extraction}\) and \(\mathrm{lem:uniform\mbox{-}pre\mbox{-}score\mbox{-}linearization}\); equations (18)--(26) on that subsubsequence contradict the violation.

We next prove the diameter order.  On the Gaussian tail box, \(\|V_h\|\leq2G/\lambda\), endpoint coefficients are bounded by \(D\), and the number of endpoints is fixed.  Outside the box, Gaussian second moments and Markov's inequality give a uniform \(O_{\Pr}(1)\) bound for the common cutoff.  Thus \(\overline c_\ell=O_{\Pr}(1)\).  Leaving out a pilot fraction changes a pre empirical process by
\[
 O_{\Pr}(\sqrt{r_{n,\ell}}/n_\ell)=O_{\Pr}(n_\ell^{-5/8})
\]
and changes a post empirical CDF by \(O_{\Pr}(m_\ell^{-5/8})\).  The smooth inverse bound and the transport inequality used in \(\mathrm{thm:honest\mbox{-}rate\mbox{-}ball}\) imply
\[
 T^\circ_\ell=O_{\Pr}(n_\ell^{-5/8}+m_\ell^{-5/16})
 =o_{\Pr}(n_\ell^{-1/2}+m_\ell^{-1/4})
\tag{28}
\]
uniformly.  Since \(a^M_\ell/a_\ell\to1\), the successful radius has order
\(\sqrt{a_\ell}=O(n_\ell^{-1/2}+m_\ell^{-1/4})\).  The fallback has the same order by \(\mathrm{thm:honest\mbox{-}rate\mbox{-}ball}\).  The product-ball diameter is twice its radius, proving the assertion.

Fix now a supported local stratum.  Pilot DKW and binomial widths tend to zero in unscaled coordinates.  Equations (16)--(17) show Hausdorff convergence of every bounded within-cell offset interval to its true value.  Interior weights and fixed unscaled knot gaps are eventually separated; local face offsets and cross-cell root-scale translations are never estimated and converge instead to their full compatible coordinates in \(\Gamma_\eta\).  Equations (10)--(11) consistently recover \(H,w^0,\Omega\) and every covariance entry, with all compatible limiting ranks retained until their eigenvalue intervals separate.  Consequently
\[
 \widehat{\mathcal K}_\ell/\{\text{irrelevant translations}\}
 \longrightarrow \{\eta\}\times\Gamma_\eta
\tag{29}
\]
in the Painleve--Kuratowski, equivalently finite-dimensional local Hausdorff, sense on each certified tail box.  The deterministic complexity bound makes work-budget fallback impossible; (18) makes primitive-certification fallback probability \(o(1)\).

The loss is continuous on every enumerated compact cell, and the compactification in \(\mathrm{thm:oracle\mbox{-}common\mbox{-}cutoff}\) is exact on the tail box.  Therefore (29), tail enlargement, and interval width \(\zeta_\ell\to0\) give
\[
 \overline c_\ell\longrightarrow c^*(\eta,\alpha)
 \quad\text{conditionally on }\mathscr S_\eta.
\tag{30}
\]
At an atom of the critical law, the upper bracket and additive cushion approach the same left cutoff from above, so (30) does not require quantile continuity.  Combining (22), (28), (30), and \(a^M_\ell/a_\ell\to1\) yields
\[
 \frac{R_\ell^2}{a_\ell}
 =\frac{a^M_\ell}{a_\ell}(\overline c_\ell+\delta_\ell)+o_{\Pr}(1)
 \longrightarrow c^*(\eta,\alpha)
\tag{31}
\]
in conditional probability.  If knots have fixed unscaled separation, their root-\(m_\ell\) gaps dominate \(R=O(\sqrt{\log(1/\zeta_\ell)})\); if every weight is bounded away from zero, all face offsets diverge beyond \(2G/\lambda\).  Only then does the nuisance set collapse.  Continuity and nondegeneracy of the resulting critical law permit the usual plug-in oracle quantile.  At a collision or face, the corresponding nuisance coordinate remains in \(\Gamma_\eta\).  The strict Bernoulli inequality in \(\mathrm{thm:bernoulli\mbox{-}honesty\mbox{-}penalty}\) then proves that replacing the common cutoff by the collision oracle would destroy uniform coverage.  This completes the proof.
body.justification: This is the load-bearing feasible-attainment result: a total Borel pilot-split algorithm retains nonestimable local nuisance coordinates, certifies the conditional common cutoff, and preserves uniform honesty and the optimal diameter rate.
body.gap: No cited comparator supplies the combined measurable support/rank/face procedure, uniform raw-to-Gaussian transfer, explicit error budgeting, certified common-cutoff calculation, and vanishing-fallback argument.
body.consumer: The result supports simultaneous unsmoothed \(L^2\) inference for the Zhai et al. mosquito-abundance QTE curves against the donor-identified no-intervention law, excluding the separate binary estimand.
